comments.body:
b397586 makes the no-cache-write test independent of the openai version: from openai 2.54.0 `InputTokensDetails.cache_write_tokens` is a required field, so validating `{"cached_tokens": 2}` raised a `ValidationError` there, while the locked 2.16.0 has no such field at all. The test now builds the details with `model_construct`; the decoder itself already falls back to 0 when the SDK does not report the field.

This comment was prepared with Claude Code.
